A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. title: Diligenciador/a (expeditor/a)
description:
A G Mining Services é uma empresa multidisciplinar que oferece serviços profissionais no setor de mineração, para projetos de mineração subterrânea e a céu aberto, em metais preciosos, básicos ou industriais. A G Mining é uma das mais importantes empresas de consultoria em engenharia de minas no Canadá, e está entre as principais empresas de renome em projetos internacionais.

A G Mining Services está em processo de expansão e consolidação no Brasil. Após o sucesso do projeto da Mina de Tocantinzinho, a empresa está abrindo um novo escritório no país, o que lhe permitirá trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os talentos locais para futuros projetos dentro do Brasil como fora.

A G Mining Services é uma empresa familiar que valoriza sua força de trabalho, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e individual com oportunidades únicas de carreira, incentivando a colaboração e oferecendo uma variedade de desafios estimulantes, tudo dentro de um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, seguro e inclusivo.

Para prosseguir o seu desenvolvimento, a G Mining está à procura de uma pessoa dinâmica e motivada para ocupar o cargo de:

Diligenciador/a (expeditor/a)

Resumo do cargo

Sob a supervisão do Chefe de Aprovisionamento / Expedição, o/a Diligenciador/a de Expedição e Logística contribui para a entrega pontual e o transporte das ordens de compra, monitorando o andamento dos fornecedores e coordenando estreitamente com os agentes de logística e os transitários.

A função consiste em garantir o cumprimento dos prazos relativos à documentação e aos materiais, identificar riscos antecipadamente, resolver problemas e coordenar as atividades de expedição, desde a adjudicação da ordem de compra até a fabricação, logística, levantamento e entrega no site. As principais responsabilidades incluem :

  • Manter comunicação constante com os fornecedores sobre o andamento da produção, prazos de entrega e disponibilidade para envio.
  • Atualizar sistemas / localizador com o status dos pedidos, o tempo estimado de entrega, o tempo estimado de chegada e eventuais exceções.
  • Acompanhar e agilizar os pedidos de compra para garantir o cumprimento das datas contratuais de “Pronto para envio” e “Pronto no site”.
  • Identificar possíveis atrasos ou riscos e coordenar proativamente as medidas corretivas; comunicar quaisquer desvios relevantes às partes interessadas.
  • Encaminhar questões críticas aos Responsáveis de Aprovisionamento e ao Gerente de Projetos, conforme necessário.
  • Coordenar com a equipe de logística para garantir um fluxo de remessas sem interrupções.
  • Dar prioridade aos materiais do caminho crítico e às entregas relacionadas ao projeto.
  • Coordenar com agentes de logística e despachantes para garantir um fluxo de remessas sem contratempos.

Requisitos

  • Graduação ou diploma em Cadeia de Suprimentos, Logística, Administração, Engenharia ou experiência profissional equivalente.
  • Experiência em expedição, suporte a compras, logística ou operações da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre ordens de compra, Incoterms, prazos de entrega e processos logísticos, além de experiência no uso das ferramentas do MS Office (especialmente o Excel).
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, coordenação e acompanhamento com fornecedores e partes interessadas internas.
  • É necessário ter proficiência em português e inglês (inglês comprovado no nível B2 ou superior), enquanto o francês e o espanhol são considerados um diferencial.

Habilidades

  • Boas habilidades analíticas, de síntese e de resolução de problemas.
  • Boa capacidade de organização, autonomia e capacidade de trabalhar em situações de pressão.
  • Gerenciar proativamente múltiplas prioridades.
  • Demonstrar iniciativa e atenção aos detalhes.

Informações adicionais

  • O cargo será baseado no escritório da G Mining Services em Belo Horizonte.

Se você se sente pronto e disposto a fazer parte de uma equipe de profissionais experientes, envolvidos em várias áreas da indústria de mineração e movidos pelo desejo de ter sucesso nos projetos em que estão envolvidos, oferecemos a vôce um desafio que corresponde às suas ambições.

Vantagens de fazer parte da nossa equipa

A G Mining se preocupa muito com o bem-estar de seus funcionários para que eles possam prosperar em todas as áreas de suas vidas. Os valores familiares da empresa se refletem em toda a gama de benefícios oferecidos aos membros de nossa equipe. Ao juntar-se à nossa equipe, você poderá desfrutar dos seguintes benefícios:

  • Seguro de Saúde e Odontológico para cuidar de nossos funcionarios e das suas familias.

title: Pesquisador

title: Analista de desenvolvimento de produtos
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nessa oportunidade o maior desafio é conduzir a gestão e evolução do portfólio de produtos de forma estratégica, garantindo competitividade, sustentabilidade e forte conexão com as necessidades do mercado, dos clientes e das áreas internas. Será um desafio integrar análises de rentabilidade, processos internos, insights de mercado e jornadas do cliente para desenvolver produtos consistentes, inovadores e rentáveis — além de atuar como protagonista no lançamento de novas soluções e na busca por oportunidades de crescimento, inclusive via parcerias e movimentos inorgânicos.

Buscamos um perfil estratégico, analítico e altamente colaborativo, com visão sistêmica e capacidade de influenciar múltiplas áreas. Um perfil que una pensamento crítico, curiosidade investigativa e foco em resultados, transformando dados e tendências em diferenciais de produto. Espera-se autonomia, protagonismo e habilidade de navegar por áreas como atuarial, comercial, CX, TI, dados e operações, garantindo entregas estruturadas, comunicação clara e olhar constante para eficiência, modernização e experiência do cliente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Propósito da posição

Atuar na gestão e evolução do portfólio de produtos da Unimed Porto Alegre, garantindo aderência às necessidades do mercado, dos clientes, na sustentabilidade do negócio e identificação de novas oportunidades de crescimento. A posição será responsável por desenvolver novos produtos, aprimorar os existentes e fomentar parcerias que fortaleçam a competitividade e a proposta de valor da cooperativa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Gestão e evolução de produtos

Conduzir análises de rentabilidade e performance dos produtos atuais, identificando oportunidades de ajustes estruturantes e aperfeiçoamento de regras de negócio.

Revisar, propor melhorias e simplificar processos internos, sempre buscando equilíbrio entre sustentabilidade, eficiência operacional e experiência do cliente.

Monitorar indicadores estratégicos e recomendar ações que ampliem competitividade e atratividade dos produtos.

Atuação integrada com áreas internas

A pessoa nessa posição precisará trabalhar muito conectada com diversas áreas estratégicas da cooperativa, incluindo:

Atuarial: construção e revisão de regras, cálculos, precificação e análises de risco;

Comercial: suporte a estratégias comerciais, posicionamento competitivo e oportunidades por segmento;

Relacionamento com Empresas e Clientes: entendimento profundo de necessidades, dores, jornadas e expectativas;

Operações, CX, TI, Jurídico, Comunicação e Dados: para garantir coerência, viabilidade e comunicação efetiva de novos produtos e atualizações.

Essa integração será essencial para garantir que as iniciativas de produto avancem com visão de ponta a ponta, unindo estratégia, execução e impacto real para o cliente.

Pesquisa, mercado e inteligência competitiva

Ao lado da área de Business Analytics, realizar mapeamento contínuo do mercado e dos concorrentes, identificando tendências, movimentos do setor, novas ofertas e diferenciais competitivos.

Levantar necessidades, desejos e comportamentos de clientes e empresas, transformando esses insights em propostas de valor relevantes.

Desenvolver análises e estudos que subsidiem decisões estratégicas de expansão, reposicionamento ou evolução de portfólio.

Desenvolvimento e lançamento de novos produtos

Conduzir o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento: ideação, validação, market fit, definição de regras, processos, jornadas, testes, comunicação, materiais de apoio e indicadores de sucesso.

Atuar como protagonista no lançamento, garantindo alinhamento entre visão estratégica, execução e acompanhamento pós implementação.

Crescimento orgânico e inorgânico

Avaliar parcerias estratégicas que ampliem ou complementem o portfólio de serviços.

Identificar e analisar oportunidades de crescimento inorgânico, como compra de carteiras e operações de M&A, construindo estudos de viabilidade e sinergia.

Competências Comportamentais Esperadas

Comunicação clara, objetiva e colaborativa

Capacidade de articular soluções e trabalhar com diversas áreas simultaneamente

Pensamento estratégico e orientação para resultados

Protagonismo, curiosidade, autonomia e visão de dono

Foco em cliente e melhoria contínua

O que esperamos desse colaborador:

Atuação estratégica e colaborativa, conectando áreas e construindo soluções integradas;

Curiosidade e postura investigativa para entender mercado, concorrência e tendências;

Capacidade de transformar dados e insights em diferenciais de produto;

Olhar crítico para oportunidades de eficiência, modernização e inovação;

Compromisso com a sustentabilidade da operação e com a excelência na experiência dos clientes.

Formação para esta posição:

  • Formação superior completa em áreas relacionadas à gestão, estratégia, análise ou desenvolvimento de produtos, tais como: Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Economia, Marketing, Gestão de Negócios, Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Estatística, Design ou Design de Serviços.

Qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida em produtos , estratégia, design de serviços ou áreas correlatas, preferencialmente em saúde suplementar, seguradoras, healthtechs ou consultorias.
  • Forte capacidade analítica , domínio de métricas e habilidade para construir business cases , estudos de mercado e análises de rentabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em jornada do cliente , modelagem de regras, desenho de processos e análise de dados.
  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico, com capacidade de influenciar e atuar com múltiplas áreas (Atuarial, Comercial, Operações, TI, CX, Jurídico, Dados, Comunicação).
  • Habilidade para conduzir todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos: ideação, validação, market fit, definição de regras e processos, testes, comunicação e indicadores de desempenho.
  • Competências comportamentais alinhadas ao papel: comunicação clara, capacidade de articulação, orientação para resultados, protagonismo, curiosidade, autonomia, visão de dono e foco em cliente.

Desejável:

  • Graduação em áreas de Produtos, Marketing, Estratégia, Inovação, Ciência de Dados ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência prévia com estudos de mercado, inteligência competitiva ou desenvolvimento de novos produtos.
  • Conhecimento de parcerias estratégicas, expansão de portfólio e movimentos inorgânicos (compra de carteiras, M&A).

description:

A pessoa irá desenvolver soluções ponta a ponta utilizando .NET (C#) no backend, Angular no frontend, Python para rotinas de IA e pipelines, além de SQL Server e bases vetoriais para persistência e busca semântica. O objetivo é entregar produtos robustos, com qualidade, segurança e boa experiência para o usuário.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver funcionalidades full stack com IA: chat corporativo, busca semântica, assistentes e copilotos;
  • Implementar e evoluir pipelines de RAG: ingestão, chunking, embeddings, indexação e retrieval
  • Integrar aplicações com LLMs via API/endpoint e/ou servidores/plataformas de inferência;
  • Construir APIs e serviços em .NET (C#) para integração com LLMs, RAG e sistemas internos
  • Implementar UI em Angular (streaming de resposta, histórico, feedback do usuário, filtros e controles)
  • Desenvolver rotinas/serviços em Python para ingestão, geração de embeddings e automações
  • Trabalhar com SQL Server e bases vetoriais (indexação e busca por similaridade com metadados)
  • Implementar tratamento de erros, resiliência (timeouts/retry) e controles operacionais
  • Atuar com segurança e governança (autenticação, autorização, trilhas e privacidade/LGPD)
  • Contribuir com boas práticas de engenharia (testes, code review, versionamento e CI/CD)

✅ Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack em produção
  • .NET (C#) para APIs/serviços (REST, autenticação/autorização, integrações)
  • Angular (componentização, consumo de APIs, estado e performance)
  • Python para rotinas de IA/integração (scripts, serviços leves, consumo de APIs)
  • SQL Server (modelagem, queries e performance básica)

Experiência prática com LLMs em produção:

  • Consumo via API/endpoint, streaming, controle de contexto e custos
  • Noções de validação/guardrails (entrada/saída, políticas e limites)

Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) em projeto real:

  • Ingestão, embeddings, indexação e retrieval (com filtros por metadados quando necessário)

Experiência com base vetorial / busca semântica:

  • pgvector, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate ou Qdrant (ou equivalente)

Experiência com inferência/model serving:

  • Integração/uso de pelo menos um: vLLM, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, Triton ou endpoint gerenciado
  • Noções de latência, concorrência e timeouts

Memória de longo prazo em aplicações com LLMs (nível sênior):

  • Persistência de histórico, preferências e contexto com critérios de retenção e privacidade
  • Armazenamento/recuperação em SQL e/ou base vetorial

Boas práticas de engenharia:

  • Git, testes, code review, CI/CD e Docker (quando aplicável)

⭐ Diferenciais:

  • MCP (Model Context Protocol): uso/integração de MCP servers para conectar LLMs a ferramentas e dados corporativos
  • Experiência com Bamboo (Atlassian) para CI/CD
  • Observabilidade avançada (dashboards, tracing, métricas de latência e qualidade)
  • Kubernetes e estratégias de autoscaling
  • Avaliação avançada de RAG/LLM (testes automatizados, datasets, A/B, quality gates)
  • Noções de fine-tuning / LoRA / PEFT (não obrigatório)

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Unlimitail

Unlimitail is a joint venture between the Carrefour Group and the Publicis Groupe, which aims to serve the growing retail media market in Europe and Latin America, developing effective solutions for the market's main needs: selling more, personalization, opportunities for brands, measurement and transparency, and omnichannel presence. The company stands out in the market today thanks to its expertise and cutting-edge advertising technology, CitrusAd powered by Epsilon, which unifies onsite and offsite resources. Additionally, Unlimitail offers global reach and high-quality data, with more than 1.5 billion monthly page views and a database of over 120 million addressable customers worldwide.

About the Position

We are looking for a person to act as a Finance Manager with a strong presence in managing operational and transactional financial activities, ensuring the quality, accuracy, and meeting of deadlines for financial information. The position will be responsible for coordinating external partners (BPO) in the accounting, tax, and treasury fronts, in addition to ensuring the consistency of numbers and supporting executive leadership with reliable financial reports and analysis. This role will have a central part in the organization and discipline of financial processes, with a direct interface with the Commercial and Operations areas, acting closely with the business.

  • Work Model: Hybrid, being 4x per week at the office in Pinheiros, São Paulo.
  • Reporting: Exposure to global reporting structures.

Main Responsibilities

  • Manage external partners (BPO) in the Accounting, Tax, and Treasury fronts, ensuring quality, accuracy, and meeting of deadlines.
  • Ensure the delivery of key financial reports within the deadline, including monthly closing, forecast (landing), and cash flow.
  • Ensure the accuracy of numbers and integrity of financial information, guaranteeing alignment between accounting and management views.
  • Act with strong mastery over revenue recognition, control of provisions, accruals, and other accounting routines.
  • Lead and monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable, billing, credit, and collection processes, ensuring operational discipline.
  • Support executive leadership with clear, organized, and reliable financial reports.
  • Act as a business partner to the Commercial and Operations areas, supporting product margin analysis, pricing definition, and decision-making.
  • Ensure consistency and quality of information used in financial planning processes, in interface with the FP&A area.
  • Structure, review, and improve financial processes, focusing on efficiency, organization, and reliability of information.
  • Maintain a close relationship with internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment and fluidity of financial processes.

Required Skills

  • Languages: Fluent English (frequent use with global stakeholders).
  • Education: Degree in Administration, Economics, Accounting, or related fields.
  • Experience: Consolidated in controllership, financial operations, and business partnering at a managerial level.
  • Management: Experience in managing external partners (BPO).
  • Technical Knowledge: Solid knowledge in revenue recognition, provisions, accounting closing, financial controls, IFRS, and BR GAAP.
  • Mindset: Experience in dynamic environments with strong growth and the need for process structuring.
  • Tools: Strong mastery of spreadsheets and analytical tools.
  • Systems: Knowledge of ERP (NetSuite desirable) and integration with tools like Salesforce.
  • Innovation: Knowledge or interest in the use of AI solutions applied to finance.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic vision
  • Leadership and team development
  • Analytical thinking
  • Executive communication
  • Change management
  • Cross-functional influence
  • Prioritization (ownership sense)
  • Data-driven decision-making capacity
  • Organization and attention to detail
  • Continuous improvement and operational efficiency
  • Continuous improvement
  • Hands-on profile and data-driven decision-making capacity.

Differentials

  • Experience in high-growth and transformation environments.
  • History in profitability and efficiency improvement projects.
  • Experience with management of outsourced structures and BPO models.
  • Prior exposure to global reporting structures.

title: Technology AVP
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

  • Build, from the ground up, the technology platform of Credit Saison Brazil’s new SCFI (Sociedade de Crédito, Financiamento e Investimento) - a regulated credit institution currently under constitution with the Central Bank of Brazil.
  • Own the end-to-end systems architecture connecting core banking, credit origination engines, ERP, cloud infrastructure, and 20+ external government and regulatory systems (BCB, B3, DETRAN, Dataprev, FGTS Digital, COAF, Serasa, among others).
  • Design, deliver and operate the Integration Layer on AWS (API Gateway, Lambda, EKS, SQS/EventBridge) that orchestrates data flows across Matera (core banking), Onidata (credit engines), Oracle Fusion (ERP) and all external partners.
  • Lead and grow a high-performing technology team, managing a combination of internal engineers and strategic vendors (core banking, ERP and credit SaaS partners).
  • Define and enforce software architecture and engineering standards, foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration and continuous learning, and be the hands-on technical authority in the room.
  • Translate business requirements from Credit, Treasury, Compliance and Operations into scalable, auditable and secure technology solutions aligned with CSBR’s growth strategy.
  • Ensure regulatory-grade infrastructure and information security: CMN Resolution 4893 / BCB Resolution 85 cyber requirements, LGPD, Open Finance readiness, and all CADOC reporting obligations applicable to an SCFI.
  • Support the launch of new credit products and the funding stack, making build-vs-buy decisions and owing to the technology budget.

Requirements

  • 10 to 14 years of progressive experience in technology leadership, solutions architecture or platform engineering, with at least the last 4–5 years in financial services (banks, SCFIs, SCDs, fintechs, BaaS providers or payment institutions);
  • Proven track record of building a platform from zero or leading a greenfield / core banking implementation — not only maintaining or optimizing existing systems;
  • Strong technical background in software architecture, systems integration and software engineering, with hands-on experience designing and operating multi-system architectures (3+ enterprise systems integrated end-to-end);
  • Solid expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure in production, regulated environments: EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, EKS/ECS, SQS/EventBridge, S3, RDS, VPC design, IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty;
  • Hands-on experience with API-first architectures, event-driven integrations, microservices, OAuth2/JWT, and patterns such as circuit breaker, retry, idempotency and data reconciliation;
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams (development, architecture, DevOps, agility) and coordinating multi-vendor delivery across simultaneous engagements;
  • Knowledge of information security programs and governance frameworks applied to financial institutions: CMN Resolution 4893 / BCB Resolution 85, LGPD, ISO 27001, SOC 2, BCP/DR, incident response, penetration testing and vulnerability management;
  • Familiarity with Brazilian financial regulation technology: COSIF chart of accounts, CADOCs, SCR, SISBACEN, PIX/SPB, B3/SNG, COAF/SISCOAF — you don’t need to know them all, but you must be fluent in what they mean for a regulated SCFI;
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) — this role has a dotted line to Saison International (Singapore) and presents to Credit Saison Japan (Tokyo); Portuguese at native level is also required;

Nice to have

  • Direct experience with core banking platforms (Matera, Temenos, Mambu, Thought Machine, Technisys) and/or Oracle Fusion ERP;
  • Experience at an SCFI, SCD, digital bank, BaaS provider or credit fintech;
  • Certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional), TOGAF, CKA/CKAD, CISSP/CISM, ITIL 4, or core banking platform certifications;
  • Experience with credit products and funding (CDB, Letras Financeiras, etc);
  • Experience building data lakehouse architectures on AWS (S3/Glue/Athena) and supporting credit analytics, portfolio monitoring and ML model pipelines;
  • Experience with Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI applied to financial services, and ability to translate those trends into practical, compliant solutions;

title: Endpoint System Engineer (REMOTE)
description:

MUST BE fluent in English.

The Endpoint Systems Engineer is responsible for managing and supporting endpoint platforms and tooling across customer environments within the Managed Services organization. This role focuses on endpoint management, patching, monitoring, and automation using centralized management tools. Endpoint Systems Engineers ensure endpoint health, compliance, and performance through proactive monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of tooling and processes.This role combines technical troubleshooting with platform ownership and automation, working closely with internal teams and customer stakeholders to maintain stable, secure, and well-managed endpoint environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the health, performance, and compliance of endpoint environments across customer environments.
  • Manage and maintain endpoint management platforms (MDM/RMM), including Intune and NinjaOne.
  • Monitor and maintain endpoint health, patching, and compliance, ensuring successful deployment and remediation of OS and application updates.
  • Investigate and resolve endpoint-related issues, including performance, configuration, and policy enforcement problems.
  • Create and manage problem investigations for recurring or complex endpoint issues.
  • Develop, test, and maintain scripts and automation (PowerShell preferred) to support endpoint management and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain integrations between endpoint management tools and other systems (e.g., ITSM, monitoring platforms).
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and support teams to resolve cross-system issues impacting endpoints.
  • Maintain endpoint configuration standards, policies, and documentation.
  • Participate in change management processes for endpoint-related updates and deployments.
  • Identify and implement improvements to endpoint management, automation, and operational processes.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • 3–6 years of experience supporting endpoint management in an MSP, enterprise IT, or similar environment.
  • Experience with endpoint management platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, other MDM solutions).
  • Experience with RMM tools (e.g., NinjaOne or similar platforms).
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID device management.
  • Experience with Windows endpoint administration and lifecycle management.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills related to endpoint systems.
  • Experience with patch management processes and tools.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.).
  • Experience working within ticketing systems and structured support processes.
  • Strong scripting skills (PowerShell preferred) for automation and tooling.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Certifications such as Microsoft, endpoint management, or cloud certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Deep experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies, including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).

title: Operations Assistant - Rezeption & Buchhaltung
description:
Über Digital Studio Rio

Digital Studio Rio unterstützt gastorientierte Betriebe mit modernen, digitalen Prozessen, klarer Kommunikation und verlässlichen Abläufen. Wir arbeiten serviceorientiert, pragmatisch und strukturiert – mit dem Ziel, dass im Hintergrund alles sauber funktioniert und Gäste sowie Teams sich auf reibungslose Prozesse verlassen können.

Deine Mission

Du unterstützt unser Team in Rio in einer zentralen Backend-Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Rezeption, Gästeservice und Buchhaltung .

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt darauf, dass Buchungen, Folios, Zahlungen, Rückerstattungen und backendseitige Abläufe korrekt und nachvollziehbar bearbeitet werden.

Gleichzeitig bist du in der Lage, bei Bedarf auch operativ zu unterstützen und als Backup für die Rezeption bzw. Gästekommunikation einzuspringen.

  • Bearbeitung und Prüfung von Folios, Buchungsdaten und Zahlungsinformationen im Backend
  • Kontrolle, ob backendseitig alle Vorgänge rund um Buchungen korrekt angelegt und verarbeitet sind
  • Bearbeitung von Rückerstattungen , Gutschriften und ähnlichen Zahlungsvorgängen
  • Abstimmung zwischen Rezeption / Gästeservice und Buchhaltung
  • Klärung von Unstimmigkeiten bei Zahlungen, Buchungen oder Abrechnungen
  • Pflege und strukturierte Dokumentation von Abläufen, Informationen und internen Standards
  • Unterstützung bei administrativen Aufgaben rund um Buchungen und Gästeprozesse
  • Bei Bedarf Backup-Unterstützung für die Rezeption , z. B. bei Gästefragen oder operativen Engpässen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem bestehenden Team in Rio
Das bringst du mit
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B1-Niveau , schriftlich und mündlich
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Gutes Verständnis für administrative und backendseitige Abläufe
  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, Systemen und standardisierten Prozessen
  • Fähigkeit, sauber, konzentriert und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten
  • Bereitschaft, sich in neue Systeme und Abläufe einzuarbeiten
  • Teamfähigkeit und klare Kommunikation
Große Vorteile für diese Rolle
  • Erfahrung in Buchhaltung, vorbereitender Buchhaltung oder Abrechnung
  • Verständnis für die Schnittstelle zwischen operativem Betrieb und Finance/Buchhaltung
  • Erfahrung mit Rückerstattungen, Zahlungsabgleichen oder Buchungskontrolle
  • Erfahrung in Hotellerie, Rezeption, Reservierung oder Gästeservice
  • Kenntnisse in DATEV sind ideal, aber keine Voraussetzung
  • Wichtig ist vor allem die Bereitschaft, sich strukturiert einzuarbeiten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
Rahmenbedingungen
  • Remote-Position in Brasilien
  • Idealerweise in Rio de Janeiro
  • Vollzeit, Teilzeit nach Absprache möglich
  • Start: so bald wie möglich
Bewerbung

Bitte bewirb dich direkt über LinkedIn mit:

  • deinem Lebenslauf auf Deutsch
  • einem kurzen Satz, warum du gut zu dieser Rolle passt

Bitte beantworte außerdem auf Deutsch diese 3 Fragen:

  1. Wo wohnst du aktuell?
  2. Wann kannst du anfangen?
  3. Ein Gast schreibt:
  4. „Wir kommen heute später an. Können wir trotzdem einchecken?“
  5. Was antwortest du?

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD

Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams.

Essential Functions

  • A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap.
  • On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices.
  • User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses.
  • Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently.
  • Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Other duties may be assigned

What you will bring / Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform; ability to collaborate effectively with development teams on implementation.
  • Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports.
  • Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses.
  • Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics.

Education and/or experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce.
  • 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team.

Core competencies

  • Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy.
  • Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively.
  • Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  • Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends.
  • Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes.

Benefits

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Finance Project Analyst
description:
What is the scope of this role?

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. Responsibilities include preparing and analyzing financial reports, collaborating with Project Managers on resourcing and discrepancies, and supporting project closeouts. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Finance Project Analyst will act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs (LOE – level of effort, T&E, 3rd party Budget consumption, milestones acceptance, invoicing and cash receipts status)
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • As a Project Financial Analyst, you will record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes

What skills and experience will you need for this role?

  • 1-3 years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Knowledge of Project Management Standard and Great Plains system.
  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode

Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

title: Senior Data Engineer - GCP
description:
You will be working for a US-based technology company with the leading Software, Web and mobile app development for business in North America helping independent retailers adopt and embrace this new key component of their digital marketing solution. We build and maintain thousands of retailer websites that must run reliably, efficiently, and effectively.

  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning

The Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in backend or platform engineering, with a focus on data-intensive systems
  • Strong experience with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development
  • Deep hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, including BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, and GKE
  • Proficient in Kubernetes for deploying and scaling data services
  • Working knowledge of React for integrating backend systems with internal tools or dashboards
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, pipelines, and streaming architectures
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for data applications
  • Strong experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) – BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Kubernetes
  • Experience with FinOps best practices and auditing procedures
  • Strong understanding of deduplication to optimize data storage and reduce cloud costs
  • Strong English communication skills

description:

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.

We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.

  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions

  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA

Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations

Company: Fulcrum SaaS

Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)

Type: Full-time

Level:  Senior / Staff

Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location

About Fulcrum SaaS

Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.

Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.

The Role

We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.

You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.

You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
  • Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
  • Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
  • Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.

What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)

  • 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
  • Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
  • Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
  • Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred; Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
  • Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
  • Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
  • Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
  • Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
  • Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).

Strong Nice-to-Haves

  • Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
  • A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
  • Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
  • Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.

What We Offer

  • Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
  • Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
  • Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
  • A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.

How to Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:

  • Your experience with Go in production.
  • The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
  • Your country of residence and preferred start date.

You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Data Reporting Specialist Contractor
description:
Great people. Greater business impact.

About CAI

CAI Software builds digital work execution platforms and software solutions that help manufacturing businesses operate with greater clarity and control. Our people bring structure to complexity by replacing fragmented, paper-based processes with connected digital workflows that improve visibility, compliance, and decision-making in real industrial environments. With 45+ years of experience and a presence across 10+ countries, CAI combines deep industry understanding with practical technology. Our team consists of ~800 employees worldwide who work across 15 core industries and support 5,000+ customers, guided by sound judgment, long-term thinking, and outcomes that endure.

CAI Business Units and the Markets We Serve

CAI Software is organized into three business units - Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing – aligned to the markets we serve. This structure allows our teams to stay close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company.

This role is part of our Shared Services team which includes the functions that support CAI business units. This model enables deep industry focus at the BU level while benefiting from the scale, expertise, and stability of one unified organization—allowing CAI Software to deliver specialized solutions.

About the Role

This contract role sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business strategy. The Reporting & Analytics Specialist will serve all three company divisions — spanning Sales, Services, Support, Marketing, and Finance — acting as the go-to resource for building, maintaining, and evolving the organization's Power BI reporting ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is not just technically skilled, but commercially minded. They understand what operational leaders need to see, can quickly pivot when business priorities shift, and excel at making complex data instantly understandable.

What You’ll Do

Power BI Development & Maintenance

  • Design, build, and deploy Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets across all three divisions
  • Develop and manage a centralized semantic layer using Power BI datasets and dataflows
  • Build and maintain DAX measures, calculated columns, and KPI frameworks
  • Implement row-level security (RLS) and role-based access controls for multi-division reporting
  • Conduct regular performance tuning of reports and data models for optimal load times
  • Maintain version control and documentation for all Power BI assets

Data Integration & Architecture

  • Connect and consolidate data from multiple source systems including CRM, ERP, marketing platforms, support ticketing, and financial systems
  • Design and manage Power Query (M) transformations for data cleansing and shaping
  • Build and maintain connections to sources such as SQL Server, Azure, SharePoint, Salesforce, HubSpot, Excel, and REST APIs
  • Identify data quality issues and collaborate with system owners to resolve them
  • Support the development of scalable data pipelines in collaboration with IT

Cross-Functional Business Intelligence

  • Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Services, Support, Marketing, and Finance to define reporting requirements and success metrics
  • Translate business questions into analytical frameworks and visual stories
  • Develop standard operating dashboards, ad hoc analyses, and executive summaries on demand
  • Provide insight-driven recommendations, not just data delivery
  • Support forecasting, pipeline analysis, revenue tracking, and operational KPI monitoring

Agility & Business Alignment

  • Rapidly reprioritize and pivot reporting deliverables as business needs shift across divisions
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects and stakeholder relationships with professionalism
  • Participate in sprint-style planning cycles to align analytics output with organizational goals
  • Proactively surface emerging data trends or anomalies to leadership

What We’re Looking For

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on Power BI development experience (required)
  • Expert-level proficiency in DAX and Power Query (M language)
  • Strong experience connecting Power BI to diverse data sources: SQL databases, APIs, cloud platforms, flat files, and SaaS tools
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts: star schemas, relationships, aggregations
  • Experience with Power BI Service administration, workspaces, and gateway management
  • Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and transformation
  • Familiarity with Azure Data Services (Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Synapse) a strong plus

Operational Domain Experience

  • Demonstrated experience supporting analytics across two or more of the following functions:
  • Sales — pipeline, win/loss, quota attainment, rep performance, forecast accuracy
  • Services / Professional Services — utilization, project margins, delivery KPIs
  • Customer Support — ticket volume, SLA adherence, CSAT, resolution metrics
  • Marketing — campaign performance, lead attribution, funnel conversion, ROI
  • Finance — P&L reporting, budget vs. actuals, AR/AP aging, revenue recognition

Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or equivalent experience
  • Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) preferred
  • Proven track record of delivering analytics in fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environments
  • Experience working across multiple business units or divisions simultaneously
  • Excellent communication skills — able to present data clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a three-division or multi-entity corporate structure
  • Familiarity with ERP platforms (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Dynamics 365)
  • Experience with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics)
  • Knowledge of Python or R for advanced analytics or data preparation
  • Exposure to Fabric, Power BI Premium, or enterprise-scale BI deployments
  • Prior contract or consulting experience supporting multiple clients concurrently

Why Join Us

You’ll have the opportunity to drive some of the most critical transformation initiatives in our company’s history. This is a highly visible role working directly with senior leadership to shape the future operating model of CAI. You’ll bring clarity, discipline, and execution focus to complex cross-functional programs while gaining exposure across every function of the business.

title: International Treasury Specialist
description:
Forno de Minas is a leading Brazilian food company with a strong heritage, recognized brands, and a growing international footprint. As the company expands its operations in the U.S. and Europe, financial governance, liquidity control, and operational excellence are critical to sustaining growth. We offer a collaborative environment with high exposure, autonomy, and direct interaction with senior leadership.

About the role

This is a highly specialized international treasury role , designed for a senior, autonomous professional.

The International Treasury Specialist will operate independently , owning treasury, cash flow, and international banking operations across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe .

This is not a transactional AP role .

It is a position with low payment volume but very high operational and compliance complexity , requiring strong judgment, technical depth, and end-to-end ownership.

Key responsibilities

Cash Flow & Liquidity Management

  • Build, manage, and continuously monitor short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts (including 13-week cash flow)
  • Ensure liquidity and funding availability for international operations
  • Analyze variances, assumptions, and scenarios impacting cash position

International Payments & Banking Operations

  • Execute and manage international payments across U.S. and European banking systems
  • Operate payment methods such as ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, wire transfers , and international payroll-related payments
  • Navigate banking environments without PIX or boletos
  • Manage FX transactions, payment cut-offs, bank holidays, and country-specific rules
  • Maintain strong relationships with international banks and service providers
  • Negotiate banking fees and service conditions when applicable

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Governance

  • Own the end-to-end international AP and AR flows, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness
  • Partner with Accounting and local providers (e.g., Portugal accounting team) for validation and execution
  • Ensure payments align with accounting, tax, and contractual requirements
  • Apply strong governance, internal controls, and compliance standards

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Work closely with HR (international payrolls and benefits), Marketing (costs and campaigns), Accounting , FP&A , and Commercial
  • Understand accounting classifications (OPEX vs. CAPEX) and financial impacts
  • Act as a key finance partner in international operations

Profile we are looking for

  • A senior, autonomous, and highly reliable professional
  • Comfortable operating alone , without constant follow-ups
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Able to manage complex international routines with precision
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and resilient in a corporate governance environment
  • Strong communication skills to interact with global stakeholders

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related fields
  • Fluent English (mandatory / non-negotiable)
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Treasury or International Finance
  • Proven experience with international payments , especially in the U.S.
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow management (build, monitor, analyze)
  • Strong understanding of financial mathematics
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP and/or Datasul – TOTVS)
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance and compliance

Nice to have

  • Spanish proficiency
  • Prior exposure to multinational or international business environments

  • Opportunity to build and structure international treasury operations

title: Remote Appointment Setter
description:
B2B Appointment Setter - Uncapped Income (Base + Pay Per Call)

Connect With Us:

  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com 

This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.

Apply Here (See Instructions Below)

(

The Opportunity: Why GP Socials

We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.

Here's What Makes Us Different:

  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.

Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):

You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.

The Role: B2B Appointment Setter

Core Responsibilities:

1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff

Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves

Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role

You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say "yeah, let's talk"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped

The Package: What's In It for You

Compensation:

  • Base: $1,500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.

The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency
  • Shape our growth - you're the first setter we're hiring. The playbook you help build is the playbook we'll scale. Great to leverage your experience in future endeavors

The Real Benefits:

  • Book calls for an agency that actually closes them - you won't be stuck in a pipeline where good leads go to die
  • Work inbound + outbound - you're not just cold-DMing strangers, you're also converting warm leads from real content
  • Your work has a direct line to revenue - every call you book is tracked, and every client signed came from a call on the calendar
  • Join a company that tripled revenue in a year and is building the most reliable content growth partner for B2B businesses

Our Values: The DNA of GP Socials

  • ⚡ Speed - Speed creates room for unavoidable errors. We move fast, test quickly, and iterate relentlessly.
  • Ownership - Everyone makes mistakes, but we'll go further when we own them and learn from them. No excuses, just solutions.
  • Grit - The more hits you can take, the more unstoppable you become. We embrace challenges as opportunities to prove what we're made of.
  • Excellence - Good isn't good enough. We're building the best content growth partner for B2B businesses, and that requires excellence in everything we do.

The Process: Fast, Transparent, Respectful

  1. Apply with resume + 3-minute Loom video (details below)
  2. Setting Work Sample - Complete a real outreach + qualification task for an actual scenario
  3. Deep Dive with Braden - Expectations discussion, portfolio review, and your questions answered
  4. Offer within 5 business days of final interview

Here's How to Stand Out:

Apply Here: (

Include:

  1. Your resume/LinkedIn and any proof of past setting results (booked call numbers, show rates, closed deals you contributed to, screenshots of pipeline dashboards, etc. )
  2. A 3-minute Loom video covering:
  • Your biggest setting win (specific numbers: calls booked per month, show rate, deals closed - the more specific, the better)
  • Why GP Socials specifically (not just "I need a job")
  • The core value from above that resonates most with you and why
  1. Optional but impressive: A short case study showing a specific setting campaign you ran - what the ICP was, what your opening DM looked like, and what the results were

﻿

The Work Sample (What to Expect in Round 2):

If you advance, we'll send you a short work sample that mirrors the actual job

You will deliver:

  • An opening LinkedIn DM (your exact words, as you'd send it)
  • A 3-message follow-up sequence
  • How you'd respond to 2-3 common objections
  • A brief explanation of your reasoning

This shows us: Can you actually write? Do you understand B2B positioning? Can you handle objections without getting stiff or defensive?

PS - A Personal Note from Braden Ricchini, Founder

The sad truth is that most agencies treat setters like number-hitters. Send 200 DMs a day, copy-paste the templates, book whatever lands on the calendar, move on. 

But I'm looking for someone who gets obsessed with the craft. Someone who studies the DMs that worked and asks "what exactly made this one convert?" Someone who can tell the difference between a lead that'll close and a lead that'll waste my hour. Someone who cares about show rates, not just book rates. Basically, I'm looking for people who are hungry.

If you're the kind of person who geeks out over sales psychology, who tracks their own reply rates obsessively, who genuinely cares whether the calls you book turn into clients or just fill the calendar, then we should definitely connect.

We're small, we're scaling fast, and you'll have a front-row seat to building a B2B sales system from scratch. No fluff, no fake promises. 

— Braden

PPS: Still reading? That's the kind of attention to detail we need. Mention the word "Easter Egg" somewhere in your application for bonus points.

title: Almoxarife Junior
description:

• Realizar as distribuições de insumos / bebidas conforme as solicitações de cada evento / espaço seguindo a requisição;

• Após fazer a distribuição solicitar o de acordo do responsável da cozinha / coordenador de eventos.

title: Operations Director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director

Introduction:

Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.

This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.

Compensation:

  • $40,000-90,000 USD per year.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Permitting

  • Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
  • Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
  • Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
  • Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
  • Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
  • Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.

Development Support

  • Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
  • File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.

Procurement

  • Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
  • Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
  • Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.

Transaction Support

  • Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
  • Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
  • Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.

Qualifications:

  • University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
  • Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
  • Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
  • Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
  • Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
  • Willing to be responsive and communicative.
  • Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST.
  • The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
  • Good attitude necessary.

title: Vice-Presidente de Operações de Varejo

Por que a experiência de varejo importa:

Nossa plataforma é poderosa, mas varejo não é “tamanho único”.

O que importa para uma rede de moda não é o mesmo que importa para um supermercado.

Por isso, não estamos buscando vendedores tradicionais.

Estamos buscando profissionais seniores de varejo que consigam:

Isso é desenvolvimento de negócios baseado em entendimento, não em “pitch”.

O que você vai fazer na prática:

  • Construir relacionamentos com organizações de varejo relevantes

Você não vai “vender software”.

Você vai conectar experiência com soluções reais.

Para quem é:

Líderes seniores de varejo, incluindo:

  • Gerentes de loja, distrito e regional

Se você já pensou:

“A tecnologia não entende de verdade o que acontece nas lojas” - nós concordamos.

Foi exatamente por isso que criamos a STOREE.AI.

O que oferecemos:

  • Remuneração por comissão, com possibilidade de efetivação full-time
  • Chance de entrar antes de uma grande escala global
  • Tecnologia real, já funcionando no campo

Isso não é um emprego.

title: Business Analyst
description:
The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. This professional will help translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items and ensure alignment between stakeholders and the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the right hand of the Product Owner, providing continuous support in backlog management and requirement definition.
  • Support the PO in the creation, refinement, and maintenance of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria, ensuring clarity and business value.
  • Prepare and support backlog refinement sessions, ensuring stories are well‑defined, estimated, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Serve as a key point of support for the squad to clarify requirements, scope, and dependencies on behalf of the PO.
  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad’s delivery capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Hands‑on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

Estamos em uma fase importante de crescimento e maturidade.

Já temos produto, mercado e base. Agora queremos elevar o nível da nossa entrega e da experiência do cliente.

Por isso, buscamos gente forte.

Você será a pessoa responsável por conduzir o cliente durante a implantação da solução GOEVO SCM , garantindo organização, alinhamento funcional, avanço do projeto, treinamento dos usuários e preparação para o go-live.

Na prática, você será a principal referência do cliente durante o onboarding.

Seu papel não será apenas “acompanhar”.

Seu papel será liderar a implantação com postura consultiva e senso de dono .

O que esperamos de você

O tipo de profissional que queremos

  • organização
  • capacidade de condução
  • visão funcional
  • boa comunicação
  • postura consultiva
  • foco em execução

Queremos alguém que saiba:

  • liderar reunião
  • entender processo
  • organizar projeto
  • cobrar o cliente quando necessário
  • treinar com clareza
  • gerar confiança

  • Facilidade para entender processos de negócio
  • Boa condução de reuniões
  • Perfil proativo, consultivo e orientado à execução

  • Experiência com ERP, SaaS B2B ou software corporativo
  • Vivência com processos de compras, supply, financeiro, workflow, aprovações ou backoffice

  • Contato com ambientes integrados a Protheus, SAP Business One, Omie, Sankhya ou similares

O que você vai encontrar aqui

  • Espaço para construir
  • Proximidade com liderança

  • Oportunidade de assumir protagonismo em uma etapa crítica do negócio

title: Consultor de Energia
description:
Sobre a Empresa

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Sobre a Função

Gerir, otimizar e monetizar o portfólio energético da Arauco Brasil, incluindo autoprodução e comercialização de excedentes no mercado livre e regulado, atuando na interface entre áreas industrial, financeira e jurídica, buscando maximizar resultados econômicos por meio da gestão eficiente de contratos, análise de mercado e conformidade regulatória.

  • Desenvolver estratégias de comercialização do excedente energético e otimizar a alocação de energia entre consumo próprio e venda, visando maximização de receita e redução de custos;
